items.title: 53566_Benjamin F.
items.q: when Old Man Thornburgh who owned the place come down and hired us to play

ctx.x: I think they have a subway station there now --the Bay Area Rapid Transit.

Well, anyway, when Old Man Thornburgh who owned the place come down and hired us to play, the Union kicked because we weren't Union people. They didn't want us to go in there, so we had to go and take a musical examination at the Union, and they said I could read, and the saxophone could read...I mean I could read and the clarinet player could read and the flute player could read but the piano player and the drummer and the bass player couldn't read, so they all...in other words, they split up our band.
